description: This file contains implementation of media utility functions, class methods, operator overloads, and helper functions related to media stream info, sample info, and video properties within the starboard namespace. It includes functions for assigning, comparing, and converting media stream info structures, as well as utility functions for video and audio data processing.

classes.name: AudioStreamInfo
classes.description: Represents audio stream information including codec, mime type, channels, sample rate, and configuration data.

classes.name: AudioSampleInfo
classes.description: Contains information about individual audio samples, including stream info and discarded durations.

classes.name: VideoStreamInfo
classes.description: Represents video stream information such as codec, mime type, resolution, and color metadata.

classes.name: VideoSampleInfo
classes.description: Contains information about individual video samples, including stream info and key frame status.

methods.name: Assign (template for StreamInfo to AudioStreamInfo/VideoStreamInfo)
methods.description: Assigns data from a generic stream info structure to specific audio or video stream info.

methods.name: ConvertTo (for stream info structures)
methods.description: Converts internal stream info structures to external API structures.

methods.name: operator= (assignment operators for stream info classes)
methods.description: Assigns external API stream info structures to internal representations.

methods.name: operator== / operator!= (comparison operators for stream info structures)
methods.description: Checks equality or inequality between stream info structures.

methods.name: GetBytesPerSample
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes per audio sample based on sample type.

methods.name: GetStringRepresentation
methods.description: Returns a string representation of binary data, printable characters or '?' for non-printable.

methods.name: GetMixedRepresentation
methods.description: Returns a hex and string mixed representation of binary data for debugging.

methods.name: IsAudioSampleInfoSubstantiallyDifferent
methods.description: Checks if two audio stream info objects differ significantly.

methods.name: AudioDurationToFrames
methods.description: Converts audio duration in microseconds to frame count.

methods.name: AudioFramesToDuration
methods.description: Converts frame count to duration in microseconds.

methods.name: IsSDRVideo (int bit depth and metadata)
methods.description: Determines if video is SDR based on bit depth and color metadata parameters.

methods.name: IsSDRVideo (mime string)
methods.description: Determines if video is SDR based on mime type and codec profile.
